_about: Vector A — scrape builders from a public building-permit feed. Find your city/county 'building permits' open-data API (KCMO: data.kcmo.org → search 'permits' → API/SODA endpoint). Replace the VERIFY_ values, then: node tools/pull-permits.js --source config/permit-sources.json --out samples/builders.json . For permit portals that need a real browser, run an Apify actor and ingest with tools/apify.js instead.
